name: CoinDesk
description: The CoinDesk Data & Indices Connector provides real-time and historical digital asset market data powered by institutional-grade infrastructure. Access regulated indices, benchmarks, spot prices, futures, and options data across leading exchanges — including funding rates, open interest, orderbook depth, and trade history. Built for traders, analysts, and researchers who need comprehensive, cross-market digital asset intelligence through natural language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CoinDesk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CoinDesk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.coindesk.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CoinDesk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CoinDesk lists 24 MCP tools, including fetch_spot_instruments, fetch_spot_tick, fetch_spot_ohlcv, fetch_spot_orderbook, fetch_spot_trades, fetch_spot_toplist, fetch_index_tick, fetch_index_ohlcv, fetch_futures_instruments, fetch_futures_tick, fetch_futures_ohlcv, and fetch_futures_oi_tick.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CoinDesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CoinDesk in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
CoinDesk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CoinDesk is developed by CoinDesk. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
